remedies.description: Add mandatory IBAN format validation at the point of payment entry (or in payment-db ingest) to reject malformed IBANs before they cause refund failures.
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Can be implemented as a configuration or simple validation rule; well within the 225‑minute budget and no constraints are specified.
remedies.residual_gap: Existing failed refunds (E-02) still need resolution and customers may continue to inquire until the failure count drops; perception of delay may linger until the failure rate improves.

output.rationale: Validate IBAN format to eliminate refund failures caused by IBAN errors (E-02, F-04, F-05) and meet success criterion SC‑SC2; side effect is upstream rejection of malformed IBANs; reversible by toggling validation; alternatives include manual cleanup, self‑service status, or enhanced notifications.

output.summary: IBAN format errors in refund payment data cause failed refunds, leading to customer inquiries about refund status that are perceived as slow response times. This is supported by evidence of five IBAN‑format failures (E-02) and stakeholder reports of perceived slowness (E-03).
key_points: Ticket‑db data show a median response time of 2.0 h, well within the 24‑h SLA (E-01), indicating responses are timely. Payment‑db data show all five refund failures are due to IBAN format errors (E-02), and stakeholder interviews describe perceived wait times as excessive (E-03).
The release delivers the minimum useful scope: validate IBAN format for refund payment data (DA‑PAY) as specified in work item W‑WORK‑ITEMS and solution design SD‑1.

The DEFINE Gate passed conditionally, deferring the customer‑notification and self‑service verification (VOB‑U‑U1, U‑U1) while the bank‑api tool remains degraded (bank‑api), leading to a release with known limitations.

Known limitations include the deferred verification of whether customers actually inquire about failed refunds due to IBAN errors (VOB‑U‑U1, U‑U1), the open unknown about IBAN errors being the dominant failure cause (U‑U2), and the degraded state of the bank‑api tool (bank‑api).
